statement.plain_text: For integers a and b, there exist integers x and y such that ax + by = gcd(a,b).
statement.markdown: For integers $a,b$, there exist integers $x,y$ such that $ax+by=\gcd(a,b)$.
statement.latex: \text{For integers } a,b, \text{ there exist integers } x,y \text{ such that } ax+by=\gcd(a,b).

proof_outline_steps.plain_text: Apply the Euclidean algorithm and back-substitute.
proof_outline_steps.markdown: Apply the Euclidean algorithm and back-substitute.
